Loss report: tekton -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider tekton (resources) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.if (no trigger of the pipeline has a Woodpecker event; the workflow never runs)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider tekton (bindings, listener, name, serviceAccountName, serviceAccountScope, template) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.api (Woodpecker starts API pipelines as manual events)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
